policy_rules: Chest pain, pressure, tightness or discomfort.
That's why it's important to know the symptoms of a heart attack and call 911 if you or someone else is having them. You should call, even if you are not sure that it is a heart attack.

\b(cold sweat|breaking out in a sweat|short(ness)? of breath|lightheaded)\b
Cold sweat, shortness of breath or light-headedness.
That's why it's important to know the symptoms of a heart attack and call 911 if you or someone else is having them. You should call, even if you are not sure that it is a heart attack.
Facial droop, slurred speech or sudden one-sided weakness.
If you think that you or someone else is having a stroke, call 911 right away.
Sudden numbness, confusion, vision loss, severe headache or loss of balance.
If you think that you or someone else is having a stroke, call 911 right away.
Airway swelling or breathing difficulty suggesting a serious allergic reaction.
If someone is having a serious allergic reaction, call 911.
\b(kill myself|end my life|suicid\w*|don'?t want to (be here|live)|hurt myself)\b
Statements indicating suicidal thoughts or self-harm.
If you or someone you know has the warning signs for suicide, get help right away, especially if there is a change in behavior. If it is an emergency, dial 911.
